description: Identify how potential customers first learn about the business
interview_questions: How do most new customers find you?|What marketing channels work best?|Do people discover you online or offline?|What brings people to your door/site?

description: Understand what customers search for and information they seek
interview_questions: What are people looking for when they find you?|What questions do they ask before visiting?|What keywords or phrases do they use?|What problem are they trying to solve?

description: Evaluate initial touchpoints across all channels
interview_questions: What's the first thing customers see/experience?|How does your storefront/website look?|What impression does signage/homepage give?|Is it clear what you offer?

description: Map word-of-mouth and recommendation pathways
interview_questions: Who refers customers to you?|What do satisfied customers tell their friends?|Are there key influencers or connectors?|How do referrals typically happen?

description: Understand how customers evaluate you vs alternatives
interview_questions: Who else are customers considering?|What makes people choose you over competitors?|What do competitors do better?|What's your unique advantage?

description: Assess ease of finding key information before purchase/visit
interview_questions: Can customers easily find hours location pricing?|Is your contact info accessible?|Do you answer common questions upfront?|What information is missing or hard to find?

description: Identify elements that build or erode confidence
interview_questions: What builds trust before first visit?|Do you display reviews or testimonials?|Are credentials/certifications visible?|What makes customers feel confident choosing you?

description: Uncover what tips customers from considering to acting
interview_questions: What finally convinces someone to visit/buy?|What overcomes hesitation?|What creates urgency?|What questions need answering first?

description: Identify friction preventing first purchase or visit
interview_questions: What stops people from trying you out?|Is parking/location an issue?|Are prices unclear or intimidating?|Do policies create hesitation?|What makes it hard to take the first step?

description: Map the moment of arrival at physical location or website
interview_questions: What happens when customer arrives?|How are they greeted?|Is it easy to know what to do next?|What's the immediate feeling upon entry?

description: Detail the core service or purchase process
interview_questions: Walk me through a typical customer interaction|Who do they interact with?|What are the key moments in the service?|Where do things get complicated?|What delights or frustrates?

description: Understand perceived and actual waiting experiences
interview_questions: Where do customers wait?|How long are typical waits?|Is waiting time communicated?|How is waiting made more pleasant?|When does waiting feel too long?

description: Evaluate space atmosphere and comfort for brick-and-mortar
interview_questions: How does the space feel?|Is it comfortable/welcoming?|What sensory elements stand out?|Is navigation intuitive?|What creates ambiance?

description: Assess online interaction quality for e-commerce or services
interview_questions: How smooth is the online experience?|Where do people get stuck?|Is mobile experience good?|Are forms/checkout easy?|What causes abandonment?

description: Examine checkout or payment touchpoint
interview_questions: How do customers pay?|Is payment process smooth?|Are options clearly communicated?|Any friction at checkout?|What payment methods do you accept?

description: Map the ending moment of interaction
interview_questions: How does the experience end?|What's the last thing customers experience?|Is there a memorable goodbye?|Do they leave satisfied?|What's the exit process?

description: Catalog all customer frustrations and obstacles
interview_questions: What do customers complain about most?|Where do they get frustrated?|What causes confusion?|What almost makes them leave?|What's consistently problematic?

description: Identify where customers drop off or don't complete
interview_questions: Where do customers quit mid-process?|What causes people to leave without buying?|When do appointments get cancelled?|What steps lose the most people?

description: Map moments of customer uncertainty or unclear expectations
interview_questions: What questions do customers ask repeatedly?|Where do people look lost or confused?|What requires explanation?|Where do misunderstandings happen?

description: Identify physical or cognitive accessibility issues
interview_questions: Is your business accessible to all?|Are there mobility barriers?|Is signage clear for all abilities?|Do you accommodate different needs?|What groups might struggle?

description: Identify and design unexpected positive experiences
interview_questions: What surprises and delights customers?|Where could you exceed expectations?|What would make someone say 'wow'?|What memorable touches could you add?|When can you over-deliver?

description: Find ways to make experience feel tailored to individual
interview_questions: How do you personalize the experience?|Do you remember repeat customers?|Can you customize offerings?|What makes customers feel special?|How do you show you know them?

description: Map moments of peak positive emotion in journey
interview_questions: When are customers happiest?|What creates joy or excitement?|When do they smile or laugh?|What moment would they photograph?|What do they talk about after?

description: Evaluate post-purchase communication and relationship building
interview_questions: How do you stay in touch after first visit?|Do you follow up?|What brings customers back?|How do you nurture the relationship?|What ongoing communication exists?

description: Identify what turns first-timers into regulars
interview_questions: Why do customers return?|What makes someone a regular?|What creates loyalty?|Who are your most loyal customers?|What do repeat customers love?

description: Understand how to re-engage dormant customers
interview_questions: How do you win back lost customers?|Why do customers stop coming?|Have you tried re-engagement?|What would bring someone back?|How do you identify inactive customers?

description: Find opportunities for customers to become promoters
interview_questions: When do customers recommend you?|What makes people share or post about you?|Who are your biggest advocates?|What triggers word-of-mouth?|How can you make sharing easier?

description: Explore ways to deepen customer relationship over time
interview_questions: How do customers spend more over time?|What's the progression of engagement?|Do customers try new offerings?|How do you upsell or cross-sell?|What's the path from new to VIP?
